messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime-prod fnexec error rate spiked to ~250% over baseline in the last 30s. Symptoms: agent/func execs returning 503s and timeouts; structured-output pipeline backpressure increasing. Auto-tagging: fnexec, structured-output, latency.
alex: Oncall alex here — taking lead. Paging SRE and ops.
maya: I see the same on dashboards (fnexec p50/p95 jump). Preparing a surgical traffic-shape.
joel: Suggest soft per-tenant cap on agent-exec calls by plan: free-tier -> 0.5rps, standard -> 1rps, enterprise keep. Can we apply immediately?
alex: Agree, we'll do plan-scoped caps + switch structured_output to minimal to reduce CPU/parse overhead. Applying now: 
```
redwoodctl mitigation apply --target=runtime-prod --component=fnexec --scope=plan:free --limit=0.5rps --reason="auto-surge-2026-03-17"
redwoodctl config set runtime.structured_output.mode=minimal --env=prod --reason="reduce-parser-work"
```
deploy-bot: mitigation-job-1123 started: applying rate-limits and config changes to prod (rolling).
maya: I've tailing logs: starting to see fewer 5xx from fnexec workers. Watching metrics for 60s.
sam: @cs-lina heads up — any customers on free plan that are high-touch or on-call? We should preemptively notify if we extend caps.
cs-lina: Notified top impacted tenants (acme-corp, betaapp). Acme reported degraded flows; raising CS ticket and sending short status note now.
joel: If error-rate doesn't come down we should consider disabling non-critical agent features (external-action plugins) for non-SLA plans. Prep a rapid rollback plan so we can restore quickly.
alex: Good call. I'll add a safety rollback script and a flag to toggle external-action execution: 
```
redwoodctl feature toggle --name=external-agent-exec --scope=plan:free --state=off --reason="surge-mitigation"
```
maya: Metrics update (1m after mitigation): fnexec success-rate 45% -> 68%, request latency flat, structured_output queue depth down 40% :white_check_mark:. If numbers hold for 5m we relax slightly.
alex: Handing off monitoring to @maya for the next 30m (my shift ends in 25m). If we see recurrence or CPU climbs, escalate to platform lead (@joel).
maya: ack — I'll post 5m and 15m updates and escalate if needed. Also will collect a short post-incident note and list of tenants affected for ops.
incident-bot: mitigation-job-1123 completed successfully; actions logged to audit (ticket: MIT-1123).
alex: Thanks team. CS to send customer comms template to affected tenants; ops follow up with a runbook to propose longer-term capacity changes.
cs-lina: Sending customer note now and will attach current status.
maya: closing thread for primary actions; will re-open if we need further intervention
